targetTasks.summary: Read AGENTS.md, active state root, Test rules, and Design/docs/current/alembic-proactive-activation-2026-07-03.md §7/§10.6 before executing. This is P4 real-machine verification only; do not edit product code. Use the accepted P0-P3 controller evidence as preconditions: P0 usage baseline + Claude Code .claude/skills proof, P1 consumption wording/guidance, P1b WS-5 managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md block, P2 host-aware skill export, P2b cold-start final refreshKnowledgeSkills auto-sync, and P3 source-presence onboarding. On a real non-empty project, perform installed-flow validation in both hosts (Codex and Claude Code): run/observe cold-start through completion, then prove without manual refresh that the correct host context file is written (Codex AGENTS.md, Claude Code CLAUDE.md), contains only the Alembic managed block, preserves user content, and is actually loaded into the host LLM context; verify per-project skills are visible/loaded where the host supports them, with Claude Code using .claude/skills per P0; exercise an 'edit code' and a 'answer project question' scenario and capture the host calling alembic_prime then alembic_search and/or alembic_recipe_map/alembic_graph; compare session usage.byTool counts against the P0 baseline and show an increase for the knowledge tools; verify empty project and ghost-mode projects stay quiet (no CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md write, no unsolicited prime, no bootstrap harassment); verify KB deletion/removal path removes the managed block without deleting the user file; verify four-tool output contract/schema is unchanged and no automatic cold-start is triggered beyond the explicit tested flow. Protect real ~/.asd: use the configured real test workspace/sandbox policy from Test rules and report exact roots touched. If blocked, return the first precise blocker with raw logs/screenshots/status JSON, not a guessed product fix. Acceptance evidence required: host-session transcripts or screenshots proving LLM context load, generated context file paths and before/after snippets, skill path evidence, tool-call sequence logs, status usage JSON baseline vs after, empty/ghost quiet evidence, KB-delete cleanup evidence, contract/schema command output, and pass/block conclusion.
